rev.label: Revenue (Sales, TTM-FY $M)
rev.ideal: bigger = more scale; compare within peers

sps.label: Sales / share
sps.ideal: context for P/S; growth vs prior years is the tell

eps.label: EPS (diluted)
eps.ideal: positive & growing; compare to price for P/E

bvps.label: Book value / share
bvps.ideal: vs price = P/B; asset-light firms run low

roe.label: Return on equity
roe.ideal: sweet spot 15–25%; >45% often leverage, not skill

cur.label: Current ratio
cur.ideal: sweet spot 1.5–2.5; <1 liquidity risk, >3 lazy cash

at.label: Asset turnover
at.ideal: revenue per $ of assets; sector-dependent, higher=leaner

invt.label: Inventory turnover
invt.ideal: higher = leaner inventory; n/a for asset-light
